LAB_RANDOM.planted: pure random walk with +6 bps/day drift, no autocorrelation

LAB_MR.planted: Ornstein-Uhlenbeck spread, half-life about 28 bars, around a slow random trend

LAB_MR.good_for: Week 5 RSI/Bollinger, cost-death autopsy (the exact headline of several graveyard entries)

LAB_PAIR_A.planted: common stochastic trend; partner B = 1.3 x A + OU spread, half-life approx 17 bars
LAB_PAIR_A.expected: cointegration tests pass in-sample; the spread trade works for 80% of the sample

LAB_PAIR_B.planted: same as A until bar 2080, then a slow structural break (+15 bps/day drift)
LAB_PAIR_B.expected: cointegration FAILS on the full sample but PASSES in-sample; the pair trade dies in the last 20%
LAB_PAIR_B.good_for: teaching that cointegration is a property of a period, not of a pair (Week 8 lesson, C18)

LAB_VOL.planted: volatility clusters with jumps to 2.6x, and mean returns fall as vol rises
